snippet.title: GGParty - Open World Trailer (alpha)
snippet.description:
This is the first Open World Trailer for GG-Party. #gg #ggparty
This is real in-game raw footage. 

We know it's your first time seeing the open world, but the footage is already a bit older. There have been major visual and game design improvements to the open world since then, and we want to show you that with updated teasers coming soon.

If you like it, go to Steam and add it to your wishlist here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796340/GGParty
